headline: PI AgSciences Targets R$ 100 Million in Brazil Crop Protection Sales by 2030
summary: Indian agrochemical firm PI AgSciences, led in Brazil by Jonas Cuzzi, projects sales above R$ 35 million in 2026 and aims for R$ 100 million by 2030, supported by new products targeting soybean and corn markets.
why: Expansion strategies by foreign agrochemical suppliers into major agricultural markets like Brazil indicate competitive shifts in crop protection input spending.

impacts.name: PI AgSciences
impacts.why: The company issued an optimistic sales forecast and expansion targets for the Brazilian market.
